result.description:
Flexiforce Australia is seeking Process Workers to join our team on both day and afternoon shifts at our clients Moss Vale NSW facility. This is a casual position with full-time ongoing hours that play a vital role in our clients manufacturing and assembly operations. As a Process Worker, you will be instrumental in ensuring production lines run smoothly and efficiently, directly contributing to the quality of products and the success of our client's business. This role offers stability, hands-on work, and the opportunity to be part of a dedicated manufacturing team.

What you'll be doing

1.	Operating and monitoring production line machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance
2.	Assembling products according to specifications and quality standards
3.	Inspecting finished products for quality control and identifying any defects or issues
4.	Preparing materials and components for processing stages
5.	Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in compliance with health and safety regulations
6.	Recording production data and reporting any equipment malfunctions or concerns to supervisors
7.	Following standard operating procedures and work instructions accurately
8.	Collaborating with team members to meet production targets and deadlines
9.	Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and providing feedback on processes

What we're looking for

1.	Previous experience in manufacturing, assembly or process work is highly desirable
2.	Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment and meet output targets
3.	Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards
4.	Reliability and punctuality, with flexibility to work day and afternoon shifts
5.	Physical capability to perform assembly work and operate machinery safely
6.	Willingness to follow instructions and work as part of a team
7.	Basic literacy and numeracy skills
8.	A valid working visa or Australian citizenship (where applicable)

What we offer

1.	Competitive hourly rates and ongoing employment security
2.	Shift allowances for afternoon shifts
3.	Safe, well-maintained working environment
4.	Opportunity to develop manufacturing and assembly skills
5.	Supportive team environment with experienced supervisors
6.	Career progression opportunities within the organisation
7.	Compliance with all relevant workplace entitlements and condition

Our client is a leading manufacturing company committed to delivering high-quality products and services. They pride themselves on maintaining a skilled workforce, fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement, and building long-term relationships with their employees. Our clients Moss Vale facility is a hub of production and assembly operations where teamwork and efficiency are at the heart of everything they do. Our client is dedicated to providing a supportive workplace where employees can develop their skills and contribute meaningfully to their success.

Ready to join our team? Apply now to become a Process Worker at Flexiforce Australia.

If you meet the criteria and are ready to start, we want to hear from you ASAP.

About the Role

You will be working at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital. It is one of the nation's most respected hospitals, with a distinguished history of serving the health needs of local, statewide, national and international communities. Our facilities and services are world class and our staff are dedicated, innovative and caring.

The RPAH Haematology Clinical Trials Unit is seeking a motivated and compassionate Registered Nurse to join our dedicated research unit. In this role, you will provide clinical and research support for a broad portfolio of haematology clinical trials, ensuring the delivery of safe, high-quality, ethical and person-centred care to study participants. 

Working closely with medical, nursing and research staff, you will coordinate trial activities, support participant assessments and education, maintain accurate research documentation and data, and contribute to the effective conduct of clinical research in accordance with Good Clinical Practice, NSW Health policies and regulatory requirements. 

This position offers the opportunity to work in a supportive multidisciplinary environment, contribute to quality improvement initiatives, and develop your skills in clinical research while advocating for participants and promoting evidence-based practice. There is the possibility of contract extension, as this position forms part of an ongoing program of work within the unit. Contracts are renewed annually, subject to satisfactory performance.

For more information, please view thePosition Description

Ideal Candidate

Current nursing registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA).

Experience and-or interest in pursuing further training in clinical research.

Effective interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills within a multidisciplinary team.
